name: Night collage / Firs
look: Cut paper on a flat ember sky: one pitch-black jagged fir edge without contour, a drifting swarm of almond sepia eyes, lollipop figures on the snow; plate B is the negative, night

axes.base: a flat ember sky over a flat snow field; no texture
axes.line: none: black silhouettes and cut shapes without a contour; the only strokes are the figures' sticks
axes.tone: flat fills, no tone; depth is a second, rust fir row behind the pitch one
axes.planB: negative: the same frame under grade { invert: 1 }, dusk turned to night
axes.motion: the swarm drifts at 24 fps on one current; the figures move on twos; the edge holds
axes.accent: ice on one iris, the eye that looks at the viewer
axes.match: silhouette: the fir edge keeps every pixel across the cut
